scope: Capture pipeline: bounded callback handoff, worker-side WAV writes, overflow and write-failure policy
environment: Kvant, pinned CI image, docker --network none
verified_behaviors: CaptureRing refuses a block that does not fit whole, preserves order and wraps
400 stereo blocks of 257 frames from a separate capture thread are written bit for bit; the capture thread made 0 allocations and 0 write/pwrite/open/fsync calls (interposed)
A two-block ring under 200 rapid blocks overflows: written + dropped frames = captured frames; the file is whole blocks in increasing order
An injected ENOSPC after 20 blocks is reported naming failed.wav.part; finish() keeps a readable .part with exactly the written frames and the first 20 blocks intact; it is not renamed
A take refuses to replace an existing file
limits: Component level only: no PipeWire capture stream, input routing, timestamps or UI yet; the desktop cannot record.
